acceptanceCriteria: Test interrupts gate run with INT, TERM and HUP and asserts the partial transcript is retained
The gate result records the interruption explicitly (not PASS, not silently absent)
Same check for run --attempt or a recorded NOT_RUN reason
body: Decision 0544 item 4 closed CORE-FINISH-INTERRUPTED-TRANSCRIPT-PRESERVATION-1 as obsolete (script/roadmap.sh deleted by ADR-0227) and moved the open question here: whether corvint-tasks gate run (and run --attempt) retains the gate's output/transcript and a recorded outcome after a supervised INT, TERM or HUP. Currently NOT_OBSERVED. Expected: an interrupted gate leaves its partial transcript and an explicit interrupted gate result, never a silently lost transcript.
title: Does corvint-tasks gate run keep the gate transcript when interrupted by INT/TERM/HUP?
